articles.summary: Il Sole 24 Ore, Rassegna Business, and Sanità Digitale cover Vera Health's growth in Italy. The papers wrote "one in nine doctors"; the latest data already says one in six. And almost all of them arrived the same way: because a colleague showed them an answer.
articles.title: Europe Is Adopting Vera, One Country at a Time. Italy Is the Latest

articles.summary: elEconomista and El Español each published a feature today on Vera Health's expansion in Spain, a market where one in seven doctors already uses the platform. Almost all of them arrived the same way: another doctor recommended it.
articles.title: Vera Health Accelerates Its Expansion in Spain: One in Seven Doctors Already Use Vera
